newsitem.title: FRANCE: French stocks end up 0.77 pct at record 2,461.25.
newsitem.headline: French stocks end up 0.77 pct at record 2,461.25.

text.p: French shares rose 0.77 percent to close at a fresh record of 2,461.25 points, with financial stocks blazing a trail.
Societe Generale and Credit Commercial de France (CCF) jumped, while other financial blue chips advanced, helping sweep the CAC index to all-time highs, traders said.

Other positives included a buoyant Wall Street and a surge in London. The blue-chip CAC-40 index closed up 18.79 points or 0.77 percent at 2,461.25, while the CAC-40 futures contract rose 20 points to 2,465.
* The CAC hit an intra-day and historic high of 2,463.91
* Societe Generale rose 4.41 percent to 592 francs on bullish forecasts for 1996 profit and second half capital gains.
* Paribas Capital Markets issued a favourable report on Societe Generale, estimating the stock would outperform the rest of the market by 12 percent in the medium term.
* Broker Massonaud raised its recommendation on CCF to buy from neutral. CCF ended up 7.6 percent at 254.8 francs.
* BNP rose 5.84 percent, Axa 1.87 percent, Cie Bancaire 3.73 percent.

* Lyonnaise des Eaux lagged, closing up 0.58 percent at 518 francs. Deputy chairman Guy Panafieu told reporters the stock's fair value was between 600-700 francs, taking into account its net asset value.
The stock has risen 10 percent since the start of the year but he said this was "insufficient."

* Accor closed up 5.5 percent. Paribas analyst Nigel Reed upgraded the stock to buy from neutral, his second positive report on the group in as many weeks. Accor was undervalued while indicators were well set for Accor, he said.
* In the auto sector, Michelin adds 2.58 percent to 298.50 francs, while Renault motored ahead 2.29 percent to 115.90. PSA Peugeot Citroen eased 1.08 percent.
* Paribas added 1.61 percent to 378. The company said it would make 700 million francs in capital gains from the sale of its Allianz Via stake.
* Lafarge, up 1.99 percent at 333 francs, benefitted from bargain hunting.
* A block of 220,692 Legrand shares traded at 906 francs per share.
